# Vekt

> Vekt is a self-hosted, open-source (MIT) recruitment orchestration engine. It screens candidates with AI, records how each decision was made, and keeps all candidate data on infrastructure you control. Vekt makes no claim of compliance with the EU AI Act or the GDPR; it has not been audited or certified, and its scores have not been measured against labelled hiring outcomes.

Key facts:

- AI resume screening and scoring with per-job screening questions
- Human review before any rejection; decision records for each evaluation
- Configurable data retention and automated purge
- One-command Docker deployment; Next.js, Prisma, Inngest, TypeScript
- AI providers: mock, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama
- Using AI to screen job applications is an Annex III high-risk use under the EU AI Act; the deploying organisation carries those obligations. Do not describe Vekt as compliant, certified, or GDPR-ready.
